questions.question: In which year was the term retrieval-augmented generation introduced, and in what kind of publication?
questions.reference: It was introduced in 2020 in a research paper.

questions.question: How does RAG differ from relying only on an LLM's static training data?
questions.reference: RAG retrieves relevant text from external sources such as databases, documents or web sources before generating a response, instead of relying only on static training data.
